Every evening the child counted the stars from the window and listened to stories in the moonlight. One night a tiny star drifted down from the sky and landed by the window. The star whispered: Will you come with me to the land of dreams? The child smiled, snuggled into a warm blanket and slowly closed both eyes. In the dream they walked on the clouds, sang with the wind and played with the waves of the sea. When morning came, the sun gently stroked the child's face. Three apples fell from the sky: one for you, one for me, and one for everyone who listened to this story.
